title: Pi compatibility evidence suite
responsibility: Establish, against the exact pinned runtime and on each supported platform, what Pi actually does where the agent-delivery design depends on it — local resolution from a consumer's own install and version match; trust grant, denial and revocation through the public API; saved API-key discovery and provider auth status; configuration-directory resolution under default and overridden settings; the literal package entry `pi install -l` writes and its canonical equivalence to the committed form; extension, skill and prompt loading; skill-override precedence; session relocation; task binding with closed stdin; the default and allowlisted tool sets; and provider-scoped environment authentication reaching a child — each with a negative control and redaction assertions, retained as tests in the normal suite so a later version bump must re-prove the contract rather than inherit it.
notes: ⚠️ IT IS A GATE, NOT A CONVENIENCE. Every design position downstream of it was an assumption carried from measurements taken on a different version. ⚠️ NEGATIVE EVIDENCE REQUIRES PROOF THAT THE OBSERVATION POINT WAS REACHED, and every run records whether it did. ⚠️ TWO TIERS: the default one asserts over the retained results and FAILS when package.json's pin no longer matches the pin the evidence was taken under; the live tier re-runs the spike against a real consumer install behind KILN_PI_COMPAT=live, on one CI cell. Both are held to the SAME assertion function, because a live tier that checks less than the record is a live tier in name only. ⚠️ NARROWED 2026-09-03 AFTER REVIEW, and the removals matter more than the additions. THREE THINGS THIS COMPONENT NO LONGER CLAIMS: the authentication-only Pi TUI and its TTY behaviour (TSK-0065); OAuth discovery, which a models.json provider structurally cannot exercise (QST-0033, TSK-0066); and the Kiln capability signature, which cannot be measured because the Kiln package it belongs to does not exist yet (TSK-0067, blocked on CMP-0031). Each is scheduled rather than quietly dropped. The earlier wording listed all three as established, which is exactly the failure — a component describing work that was not there — that this whole cycle was opened to undo.
